title: Token validation moves out of the middleware
tldr: Token verification is extracted into src/auth/token-validator.ts and reused from the worker queue.

readingPlan.step: Read the new validator first; the middleware change is mechanical.

concerns.question: What verifies the signature when NODE_ENV is not production?
concerns.why: The dev branch calls decode rather than verify, so any well-formed token is accepted.

chapters.title: A reusable token validator
chapters.summary: validateToken is extracted so the worker queue can call it too.
chapters.whyMatters: Both the HTTP path and the queue path now depend on this one function.

sections.content: The new module holds the claims type and the verification call, plus a fast path for local dev.
The queue picks it up for jobs that carry a token, setting job.actor from the sub claim.

chapters.title: Middleware delegates to the validator
chapters.summary: The middleware drops its own jsonwebtoken usage and awaits validateToken.
chapters.whyMatters: The 401 behavior has to stay identical; the try/catch is the only thing preserving it.

sections.content: Nine lines of inline verification collapse into one call, with the same catch-and-401 shape.
